scores.notes: Watercolor and ink. In the light column above the fiery throne (top center), faint ink contours draw a standing robed figure with a rounded head, shoulders and arms spread to either side. The wash also stops short of the bottom-left corner, leaving a small patch of unpainted paper.

Realistic oil. God appears only as a fire-like glow veiled in cloud (top center), with no figure in it; families with bundles, a carried child and an elder with a staff walk between the water walls. The foreground water on the left laps at the path's edge, which is minor.

Realistic oil. The Samaritan kneels at center, pouring wine onto the traveler's bandaged arm; a flask and linen strips lie at the lower right, the saddled donkey stands at left and the stone inn sits upper right in low sun.
Soft digital oil painting. The radiance above the flaming throne (top center) contains a clear luminous robed figure, with a head, shoulders and two open hands visible on either side.

Realistic oil. Two extra white-bearded elders stand inside the tabernacle doorway (upper center); the front one duplicates Moses' look, with a light tunic, dark cloak and open arms. Moses reads an open scroll with faint script-like marks instead of raising his hand to count.

Watercolor and ink. An empty wheeled throne burns at center under a plain vertical light shaft with no figure in it; empty thrones stand in the cloud-hall. Paint reaches every border, and the white at the top and bottom is the drawn light and clouds.

Gold-leaf icon style. A tiered fiery throne on four burning wheels sits empty at center, with rays and cloud above it, a river of fire below and empty thrones on both sides; I found no face or silhouette in the light.

Watercolor and ink. The white light above the burning throne (upper center) is shaped by the flames into a faint standing silhouette with a head, shoulders and body. The wash fades into blank paper at both bottom corners and the lower parts of the left and right edges.

Gold-leaf icon style. Haloed Moses (center right) raises his hand and holds a tally stick beside Aaron in priestly dress, with Levites and mothers with children on both sides. The tally stick carries small letter-like glyphs rather than simple notches.

Realistic oil. The veiled radiance (top center) is drawn as a literal valentine heart-shaped flame in the clouds, a misreading of 'glow at its heart'. On the left, the foreground water runs as open surf to the path's edge.

Realistic oil. Moses (center) raises a small tally stick and holds a staff, Aaron in priestly garments stands beside him, and Levites with mothers and children line both sides before the tabernacle at dawn. The banner shows only a winged emblem.

Watercolor and ink. An empty burning throne with fiery wheels stands at center, with a river of fire, empty thrones and a white radiance burst that has no figure. A detached burning fragment floats in the light at the upper right, which is odd but reads as part of the vision.

Gold-leaf icon style. Moses raises his hand and holds a blank tablet beside Aaron, with Levites, families and a curtain embroidered with cherubim behind. His crooked staff stands leaning on its own beside him, held by no one (center left).

Gold-leaf icon style. An empty fiery throne on burning wheels sits at center among empty thrones and blue cloud banks, with a river of fire below; the radiance above is only rays, cloud and flame, with no form.

Loose oil painting. An empty throne of white flame on wheels stands at center in a ring of empty chairs amid clouds, with a fiery river at the upper right. The bright flame mass forms the throne back, with no head or body in it.

Stylized tempera or icon-like painting. The Samaritan kneels, pouring from a flask onto the traveler, with a flask and linen strips in the dust at the lower right, the saddled donkey at left and the stone inn upper right in golden light.

Realistic oil. The scene matches, with the Samaritan kneeling and pouring, the flask and linen in the dust, the donkey and the inn. A cursive painter's signature is lettered on the rock in the bottom-right corner.

Gold-leaf icon style. The Samaritan supports the reclining traveler and pours wine from a flask while holding a cloth (center); linen lies on the ground, the saddled donkey stands right and the stone inn left.
